concepts.name: artificial intelligence tutor
concepts.definition: An artificial intelligence tutor is a system designed to answer questions.

concepts.name: collection of course documents
concepts.definition: A collection of course documents is a set of educational materials.

concepts.name: questions about a collection of course documents
concepts.definition: Inquiries specifically concerning the content within a collection of course documents.

concepts.name: tutor
concepts.definition: An artificial intelligence tutor that answers questions about a collection of course documents.

concepts.name: language model
concepts.definition: A computational tool used by the tutor to generate explanations.

concepts.name: explanations
concepts.definition: Content generated by a language model for the tutor.

concepts.name: fluent wording
concepts.definition: The quality of being fluent in language, which does not guarantee factual accuracy.

concepts.name: factual accuracy
concepts.definition: The correctness of the information provided by the tutor.

concepts.name: parameters
concepts.definition: Parameters are the adjustable components of a language model that change during training.

concepts.name: training dataset
concepts.definition: A training dataset is the source of examples used to adjust a language model's parameters.

concepts.name: examples
concepts.definition: Examples are individual data points drawn from a training dataset used for adjustment.

concepts.name: separate validation dataset
concepts.definition: A distinct collection of data used for evaluation purposes, separate from the training set.

concepts.name: model selection
concepts.definition: The process of choosing a specific model architecture or configuration based on performance.

concepts.name: choice of training settings
concepts.definition: The decision regarding hyperparameters and configurations used during the training phase.

concepts.name: held out test dataset
concepts.definition: A dataset reserved for evaluation after model selection and training settings are finalized.

concepts.name: performance
concepts.definition: The metric or outcome measured by the held-out test dataset following specific choices.

concepts.name: model selection and the choice of training settings
concepts.definition: Decisions regarding model selection and training settings made prior to testing, as referenced in the previous sentence.

concepts.name: datasets
concepts.definition: collections of data used for model training or testing

concepts.name: training
concepts.definition: the process of using datasets to train a model

concepts.name: testing
concepts.definition: the process of evaluating a model's performance on unseen data

concepts.name: passages from the same source
concepts.definition: segments of text originating from a single origin that appear in multiple datasets

concepts.name: measured performance
concepts.definition: the quantified results obtained when evaluating a model

concepts.name: models ability to handle unfamiliar material
concepts.definition: the capacity of a model to process data it has not seen during training

concepts.name: training and testing
concepts.definition: the combined processes of training and evaluating a model

concepts.name: dataset size
concepts.definition: The magnitude of the dataset used in an evaluation.

concepts.name: dataset quality
concepts.definition: The inherent standard or merit of a dataset.
